meta.title: Whale Girl Aside
meta.description: Injects the whale-girl persona and registers the whale_aside tool, whose one-line inner monologue renders as a speech bubble. The Host half speaks it with Edge TTS (zh-CN-XiaoyiNeural +22 Hz by default) and shows a mood sticker; the timbre is configurable per browser from the bubble badge or globally in ~/.dsh/whale-voice.json, and the badge always names the voice that actually spoke.
